name: Ahrefs
one_liner: SEO data platform offering backlinks, keyword, SERP, rank tracking and site audit data via API v3.
auth_notes: Direct API uses an API key created by workspace owners or admins in Account settings. Third-party apps use OAuth through Ahrefs Connect.
access_notes: API keys are created by workspace owners or admins on eligible paid plans; other plans get limited free test queries. Not enterprise-only: Ahrefs Connect apps reach Lite, Standard, Advanced and Enterprise. Ahrefs Connect needs an application and review before going live. Paid requests cost at least 50 API units.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve API keys on eligible paid plans and a documented API v3. OAuth for third-party apps needs Ahrefs Connect review. The hosted MCP endpoint may not be used for custom programmatic access.

access.quote: Ahrefs API is available on eligible paid plans.
only workspace owners and admins have access to this section.

auth.quote: send your API key as a bearer token in the `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>` header.

sandbox.quote: Users on any paid plan can test Ahrefs API by running a limited set of free test queries.

api_surface.quote: The complete OpenAPI specification for every tool is at [/openapi.json](/openapi.json).

buildability.quote: The `base_cost` of each request is **50 units**.

disputes.why: llms.txt lists a complete OpenAPI spec plus per-tool specs.
